content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Associate - I at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines) Dhanbad, Office of the Dean (Research & Development)
Mining Engineering (department of the Principal Investigator)
Development of Virtual Reality Mine Simulator for training miners to improve safety and productivity in Indian underground metal mines (IIT (ISM) Project No. SRDP 1416 G)
Upper age limit 30 years as on the closing date of application

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: B.Tech./B.E./M.Tech./M.E. in Mining Engineering or Computer Science & Engineering or Geoinformatics or Geomatics Engineering or Industrial & Safety Engineering or Related Branches. Candidate must be GATE qualified. Knowledge of underground metal mining method and familiarity with mechanized metal mining equipment and safety regulations (Metalliferous Mines Regulations 1961). Hands-on experience with 3D laser scanning / LiDAR, point-cloud processing, CAD/3D modeling, or Virtual Reality (VR) simulation tools (e.g., Unity/Unreal Engine). Strong technical writing skills evidenced by research publications or technical reports. The upper age limit is 30 years as on the closing date of application. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Female candidates will be applicable as per Government of India rules. The notice does not name a minimum age or a required length of experience. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is ₹37,000/- + HRA (@20% per month. Campus accommodation may be provided subject to availability, in which case HRA will not be paid. The project runs from 14-10-2026 to 30-11-2027. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. Based on satisfactory performance in the project, the selected candidate may be considered for enrolment into the Ph.D. programme of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, subject to fulfilment of the Institute's Ph.D. admission criteria.

content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Associate - I Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct field scanning of various underground metal mining methods, mine environments, and mechanized underground mining equipment, requiring approximately 45 days of field work for data collection. Develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) along with safety and training modules for a Virtual Reality (VR) mine simulator tailored to underground metal mines. Execute training simulations and perform data analysis. Prepare technical reports, draft research papers, and file patents related to the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Associate - I
content_sections.text: Prepare a single consolidated PDF file (or a downloadable link) containing the documents listed below. Email the application to [email protected] . Write the subject line as: "Application for Project Staff Position under Project SRDP 1416 G". Send the email by 04-12-2026 up to 06:00 PM. Detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) Scanned copies of educational certificates and mark sheets (10th standard onwards) Proof of age Valid GATE Scorecard Relevant experience certificates, if any

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their merit and suitability as per the requirements of the project. Mere possession of the minimum qualification does not guarantee an invitation to the interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the schedule of the offline interview through email. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice. At the interview, candidates should bring all original certificates and supporting documents and submit one set of photocopies of the originals, duly self-attested.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates appearing for the interview must make their own arrangements for travel and stay at Dhanbad, if required. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. HRA will not be paid when campus accommodation is provided. For queries, the notice gives the Principal Investigator's email [email protected] and mobile number +91 8603401161.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Associate - I posts are there at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad?
faq.answer: The notice announces one (01) Project Associate - I position under the TEXMiN project, SRDP 1416 G.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent by 04-12-2026 up to 06:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: B.Tech./B.E./M.Tech./M.E. in Mining Engineering or Computer Science & Engineering or Geoinformatics or Geomatics Engineering or Industrial & Safety Engineering or Related Branches. The candidate must also be GATE qualified.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years as on the closing date of application. Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Female candidates applies as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship for this post?
faq.answer: The fellowship is ₹37,000/- + HRA (@20% per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the fellowship?
faq.answer: HRA (@20% per month) is mentioned along with the ₹37,000/- fellowship. If campus accommodation is provided, subject to availability, HRA will not be paid.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email a single consolidated PDF file (or a downloadable link) with the listed documents to [email protected]. Use the subject line "Application for Project Staff Position under Project SRDP 1416 G".

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on merit and suitability as per the requirements of the project. Shortlisted candidates are then informed by email of the offline interview schedule.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, which has a tenure of 14-10-2026 to 30-11-2027.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. Candidates make their own arrangements for travel and stay at Dhanbad, if required.
